title: In vitro evaluation of CAR-T cells in patient-derived glioblastoma models
protocol: Warm required amounts of basal XSFM media at 37°C.
Collect CAR-T cells from culture day 12–15 and centrifuge at 450 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL of warmed basal XSFM.
Filter the cell suspension into a 12 × 75 mm tube with a 35 μm cell strainer cap.
Determine cell number and viability using Trypan Blue solution.
Adjust cell count as required for specific assays.
Prepare luciferase-expressing target cells at a concentration of 3 × 10^5 live cells/mL of warmed basal XSFM with 75 μg/mL D-firefly luciferin potassium salt.
Add 100 μL of cell mixture per well in a tissue culture-treated, flat-bottom 96-well plate for a total of 3 × 10^4 live cells per well.
Plate 6 wells per effector: target (E:T) ratio.
Plate cells for lysis control and media-only control.
Run each sample and control in triplicates.
Read the plate with a luminometer to ensure equal distribution of target cells.
Set luminometer settings as follows: bottom optic read, gain: 3600, time: 10 s.
Adjust CAR-T cell concentrations to 3×10^5 CAR-T cells/mL in basal XSFM with 75 μg/mL D-firefly luciferin potassium salt.
Plate 100 μL of cell mixture per well for a 1:1 E:T ratio or adjust volume accordingly for other ratios, aiming for a final volume of 200 μL per well.
For lysis controls, add 100 μL of XSFM with 75 μg/mL D-firefly luciferin potassium salt and 1% nonidet P-40 lysis buffer.
Add 100 μL of basal XSFM with 75 μg/mL D-firefly luciferin potassium salt to media-only wells.
Incubate plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 4–8 h.
Measure bioluminescence using a luminometer with settings previously described.
Prepare target cells at a concentration of 4×10^6 live cells/mL of basal XSFM.
Plate 250 μL per well in a tissue culture-treated, flat-bottom 24-well plate for each CAR-T cell being used.
Add 250 μL per well of basal XSFM without target cells as media-only controls.
Adjust the CAR-T cell concentration to 4×10^6 CAR-T cells/mL of basal XSFM.
Plate 250 μL per well in the same plate for each CAR-T cell being used.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 24–48 h.
Collect cell solution from each well after incubation.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Resuspend pellet gently in 1 ml of PBS.
Filter cell suspension into a 12 × 75 mm tube through a 35 μm cell strainer cap.
Determine live cell concentration using Trypan Blue solution.
Aliquot between 500,000 and 1,000,000 live cells per well into 12 × 75 mm tubes.
Centrifuge tubes at 300 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL of PBS with 2 mM EDTA (PBS-EDTA).
Stain cells with the respective antibody as per manufacturer’s recommendations.
Add 1 mL of PBS-EDTA to the tubes and mix gently to wash cells.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Resuspend all pellets in 150 μL of 1× 7-AAD viability stain (100-fold dilution of 7-AAD from stock in PBS-EDTA).
Prepare a 96 well plate with 200 μL basal XSFM per well (n = 3 replicates per sample).
Sort CD3+ cells into the plate at a cell density of 1000 cells/well.
Add 200 μL basal XSFM as a blank in the same plate (n = 3).
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 3 days.
Add 1× presto blue reagent into all wells (20 μL into 200 μL well; 10-fold dilution).
Incubate plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 4 h.
Read plate for relative fluorescence intensity (RFI) at an Excitation and Emission wavelength of 544 nm and 590 nm respectively.
Prepare target cells at a concentration of 4×106 live cells/mL of basal XSFM.
Plate 250 μL per well in a tissue culture-treated, flat-bottom 24-well plate.
Add 250 μL of basal XSFM per well in the same plate as media-only controls.
Adjust the CAR-T cell concentration to 4×106 cells/mL of basal XSFM.
Plate 250 μL of the cell solution per well.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment for 24 hours.
Prepare cells for flow cytometry analysis according to steps 18–24.
Stain cells with CD25/CD69/CD3 antibodies for co-staining.
Include an isotype control or unstained sample as a negative control.
Add a viability stain control using 7-AAD.
Exclude debris by gating on forward scatter (FSC)-height vs. side scatter (SSC)-height.
Eliminate doublet cells using FSC-height vs FSC-width gating.
Set the viability gate using 7-AAD to exclude non-viable cells.
Use isotype controls or unstained samples to set gates for CD3, CD25, and CD69 expression.
Analyze the CD3+ population for CD25 and CD69 markers of activation.
Mix target cells with CAR-T cells or CAR-T cells only at a 1:1 ratio in basal XSFM.
Transfer the co-cultured cells to sterile tubes and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Collect supernatant and store at −80°C for cytokine analysis.
Perform flow cytometry quantification of TNF-α and IFN-γ cytokines using Cytometric Bead Array Kit (BD Biosciences).
